extends: the v1-v4 research files, which are not modified
grade_policy: No feeding grade is assigned in the research layer. A record here is not a statement that the plant is safe to feed.

records.source_citation: Ritz, J., Griebeler, E.M., Huber, R., Clauss, M. 2010. Body size development of captive and free-ranging African spurred tortoises (Geochelone sulcata): high plasticity in reptilian growth rates. Herpetological Journal 20:213-216.
records.locality: private breeding facility, Switzerland (outdoor enclosure with grasses and shrubs in summer)
records.study_method: growth records of three captive-bred animals weighed over almost 18 years at a private breeding facility; the diet is described in the methods, not measured
records.limitations: Records what this tortoise taxon was reported to eat or be fed. It does not establish safe amounts, long-term outcomes or suitability for other tortoise species. Common name only; the diet of three animals growing much faster than wild animals, described by the authors without nutrient analysis.
